create_javascript_processor: create a JavascriptProcessor instance to tokenize and detokenize JavaScript source code using tree-sitter
tokenize_javascript_code: tokenize JavaScript source code into a list of tokens using the JavascriptProcessor tokenize_code method
detokenize_javascript_tokens: detokenize a list of JavaScript tokens back into source code using the JavascriptProcessor detokenize_code method
extract_javascript_functions: extract class and standalone functions from JavaScript source code using the JavascriptProcessor extract_functions method
get_javascript_ast: parse JavaScript source code and return its abstract syntax tree using the JavascriptProcessor get_ast method
